civic_fr.note: confidence ~1.0 everywhere; gating cannot discriminate, argmax abstain carries it

clinc150.note: 7.8% leak / 69% coverage at 0.7; 15-20% argmax abstain is weak, the floor is the gate
clinc150.qhat_note: selective-risk α=0.05 on 2766-row cal split (clinc_holdout+hn_eval): auto 46.5% (v1) / 46.2% (v2), ub95 bound ~4.5-4.8%, eval err ~3.9%. Both hosted aliases (clinc, clinc2) wired at qhat 0.95. Caveat: cal split nearly all in-scope — bound covers routing errors, not OOS recall.
clinc150.mondrian: per-class qhat: auto 4.7% at α=0.05 — wide taxonomies route through clarification sets, not singletons

eq_tone.note: weak in-scope signal (median conf 0.56): conf<0.5 tone guesses leak 7.6%/62%cov; oos class already catches non-tone at argmax

banking77.qhat_note: conformal α=0.10 on 1398-row cal split (test+id-oos mix): 46.4% auto, 9.1% err among auto, 88.3% set coverage — replaces the 0.7 floor where wired
